interface.blocker: No resolved target path currently establishes a first-class Creative Look entry, preset browser, edit screen, reset, copy, and selection workflow.
interface.acceptance: A dedicated Creative Look workflow exposes ten looks and their supported controls without relabeling the Creative Style menu.

state.blocker: No target state model is yet proven for Creative Look identifiers, defaults, per-look adjustments, validation, reset, copy, and persistence.
state.acceptance: Validated per-look records persist exact supported values across documented mode and power transitions.

base_looks.blocker: No authenticated Creative Look base tables or evidence-backed target-native representation has been located.
base_looks.acceptance: All ten named looks have authenticated or independently validated processing representations with explicit provenance.

adjustment_axes.blocker: The eight Creative Look axes have not been independently connected to target UI, state, and processing boundaries.
adjustment_axes.acceptance: Every axis has separately proven UI handling, state/default/range semantics, and a target processing path or an explicit blocker.

pipeline_binding.blocker: No Creative Look processing path is yet bound to live view, still JPEG, or movie output on the target.
pipeline_binding.acceptance: Each supported output uses the selected look and adjustments consistently, with unsupported modes reported explicitly.

menu_entry.blocker: No dedicated Creative Look menu entry or production selection dispatcher is established on the target.

ten_preset_browser.blocker: No target-native browser presenting the exact ten Creative Look presets is established.

edit_screen.blocker: No Creative Look edit screen wired to eight independent adjustment records is established.

reset_to_default.blocker: No per-look reset-to-default state transition is established.

copy_select.blocker: No Creative Look copy and selection behavior is established independently of Creative Style.

range_display.blocker: No UI path displaying authenticated ranges for all eight axes is established.

persistence.blocker: No Creative Look record persistence across documented mode and power transitions is established.

mode_restrictions.blocker: No verified availability matrix identifies Creative Look restrictions for live view, still JPEG, and movie modes.

contrast.blocker: Creative Style contrast is fallback evidence only; matching Creative Look UI, state, and processing semantics remain unproven.

highlights.blocker: No independent highlights control path is established on the target.

shadows.blocker: No independent shadows control path is established on the target.

fade.blocker: No independent fade control path is established on the target.

saturation.blocker: Creative Style saturation is fallback evidence only; matching Creative Look UI, state, and processing semantics remain unproven.

sharpness.blocker: Creative Style sharpness is fallback evidence only; matching Creative Look UI, state, and processing semantics remain unproven.

sharpness_range.blocker: No sharpness-range control distinct from sharpness is established on the target.

clarity.blocker: No clarity control distinct from sharpening is established on the target.

live_view.blocker: No live-view Creative Look sink is resolved.

still_jpeg.blocker: No still-JPEG Creative Look sink is resolved.

movie.blocker: No movie Creative Look sink is resolved.
